item.description:
• Lit by the music. The open panel takes a soft wash of the cover's color, brightest under the artwork and dimming when you pause. The top of the panel stays black, and glass and Increase Contrast are left as they were.
  • Cover art leans toward the pointer and catches a highlight where it is. Reduce Motion keeps the highlight and drops the lean.
  • Previous and Next answer the click: the glyph darts the way the track is going and springs back.
  • The equalizer bars follow you into the open panel, beside the title, in the Two pages and One at a time layouts.
  • The scrubber's played part runs from the cover's color to white, and the play button wears the color too.
  • Today's date sits on a disc of your accent color in the calendar, so it reads at a glance and not by color alone.
  • "Allow Calendar in Settings → Access" is now a button that opens Settings on that pane.
  • Fixed: with All at once showing all three columns, a narrow panel width cut the artwork and the shelf off at the edges. The panel now keeps the width that layout needs.
• The live equalizer does less work while music plays: it only redraws when a bar actually moves.
• The Motion picker in Settings → Appearance fits inside its card again, instead of Lively hanging over the edge.
